articles.title: Interface Launches noravant: A New Era in Rubber Flooring

articles.summary: Interface, Inc., the global flooring and sustainability leader, today introduces Forest Within™ and Cut & Form™, two new flooring collections that translate biophilic design into immersive, sensory-rich commercial interior environments. Debuting at Chicago Design Week, the collections transform the Interface showroom, creating visual and experiential connections to nature through design and materials. The company will also showcase its new noravant™ rubber flooring that uniquely combines design flexibility, high performance, and enhanced sustainability in an innovative PVC-free solution.

articles.summary: Interface, Inc., the global flooring and sustainability leader, today announces eight new warm colorways in its Open Air™ Neutrals carpet tile collection. The company introduces these new options as part of The Warm Edit, a curated exploration of the warm tones shaping today’s commercial interiors.

articles.summary: Interface, Inc. the global flooring solutions company and leader in sustainability, announced that Newsweek named it one of America’s Greenest Companies of 2026. The recognition acknowledges the manufacturer’s 30-year history as a sustainability leader, continued carbon reduction progress, and commitment to be carbon negative by 2040. Interface is the only flooring company on the list for the second year in a row.

articles.summary: Interface, Inc., the global flooring and sustainability leader, today released its 2025 Impact Report. The report outlines the company’s progress across environmental, social, and governance (ESG) initiatives. It highlights how responsible business practices, investments in people and culture, and continued climate progress can drive meaningful impact and create long-term value.
